northStar.name: The Pairing-Sheet Ledger
northStar.summary: A fast tournament operations ledger laid on a dark tabletop: precise ruled rows, old event-paper warmth, red action marks, and compact source-data rhythm.

mustCarryForward: Dense ruled League ledger on desktop
Readable stacked League rows on mobile
Dark tabletop shell with parchment-brown work surfaces
Brass-toned row rules and status chips
Organizer and player entry lanes above the ledger
mustNotLiteralize: Fantasy illustration as a page background
Generic SaaS cards replacing the ledger structure

league-ledger.purpose: Home page work queue for opening existing Leagues.
league-ledger.desktop: Dense table with uppercase labels, tabular counts, status chips, and right-aligned Open action.
league-ledger.mobile: Stacked rows with League name, tournament/player summary, status chip, and Open action.

entry-lanes.purpose: Separate creation from restore/import so both user types can start without reading instructions.

rules: Red means act or current target.
No teal on new Gones surfaces.
Use ruled rows and complete borders, never decorative side stripes.
Old-school Magic influence comes from ledger material and tournament-paper rhythm, not copied card art.
